src/renderer/i18n/locales/fa-ir.json — 6364 keys (exact match), 0 missing/extra, 20 placeholders/empty (19 '[to be translated]:' + 1 empty at settings.provider.oauth.provided_by_suffix)

src/renderer/i18n/resolver.ts — initI18n() loads 16 locale packs via resourcesToBackend, including fa-IR (line 38); dayjs fa locale imported (line 4) and fa-IR mapped to dayjs 'fa' (line 68); missingKeyHandler logs error (line 115-117)

findings.label: document dir attribute for fa-IR
findings.summary: RTL is implemented for fa-IR via useWindowRuntime: document.documentElement.dir is set to 'rtl' when language === 'fa-IR', else 'ltr', with cleanup on unmount. Applies to the 5 windows that mount useWindowRuntime (main, subWindow, selection/toolbar, selection/action, quickAssistant).
findings: D:\AI1\src\renderer\hooks\useWindowRuntime.ts lines 62-68 — sets dir=rtl for fa-IR, dir=ltr otherwise, removes attr on unmount
All 5 full-chrome windows mount useWindowRuntime: MainApp.tsx, SubWindowApp.tsx, SelectionToolbarApp.tsx, SelectionActionApp.tsx, QuickAssistantApp.tsx
ComposerSurface.tsx:343 — dir='auto' for user content auto-detection
BrowserHistoryDialog.tsx:229 — dir='ltr' hardcoded (the only explicit ltr usage)
AppShell.tsx — no dir attribute set
gaps: screenshot, migrationV2, userDataRelocation windows do NOT mount useWindowRuntime → no RTL dir flip in those windows
index.html files hardcode lang='zh-CN' (all windows) — HTML lang not localized to fa
AppShell.tsx does not set dir (but it is not a window root; RTL handled at document level)
strengths: Single centralized RTL switch in useWindowRuntime
Cleanup on unmount avoids leaking dir attribute
dayjs fa locale + fa-IR resolver entry present
weaknesses: RTL coverage incomplete (3 of 8 windows excluded)
dir='ltr' hardcode in BrowserHistoryDialog could override RTL in that dialog

findings.label: design motion tokens & presets
findings.summary: Motion is centralized: CSS tokens in packages/ui/src/styles/tokens/motion.css (5 durations, 3 eases, prefers-reduced-motion collapse to 0s) mirrored by JS presets in motion.ts (MOTION_DURATION, MOTION_EASE, MOTION_TRANSITION, MOTION_RESTORE_TRANSITION, MOTION_QUEUE_TRANSITION, MOTION_INSTANT_TRANSITION). prefers-reduced-motion collapses all durations to instant swap.
findings: D:\AI1\packages\ui\src\styles\tokens\motion.css — --cs-motion-duration-{fast,base,md,slow,xslow} + --cs-motion-ease-{in-out,out,queue} + --cs-motion-duration-reduced=0s; @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) collapses all to 0s

D:\AI1\packages\ui\src\styles\motion.ts — MOTION_DURATION, MOTION_EASE, MOTION_TRANSITION, MOTION_RESTORE_TRANSITION, MOTION_QUEUE_TRANSITION, MOTION_INSTANT_TRANSITION; doc comment requires parity with CSS tokens
strengths: Single source of truth for timing/easing
OS-level reduced-motion respected in one place
JS presets mirror CSS tokens with explicit sync requirement
weaknesses: Doc comment notes CSS/TS parity must be maintained manually (no automated check)
